title: The Signal of New Lagos
author: Y. M. Iversen
blurb: Isandro Reyes, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
